about: CRC's deck style as released on 2026-09-23 and reviewed with Michael. Every rule here is true of the seeded deck (CUE-MANIFEST.json + crc-seed-data.json); tests/companion-deck-style.test.ts checks it against that deck.
sources: docs/planning/2026-09-23-overlay-consistency/companion/PRESET-DESIGN.md (goals 1-5, fixed columns, cue buttons, colour legend, page map)
docs/planning/2026-09-23-overlay-consistency/companion/CUE-MANIFEST.json (every sequence: page, cell, label, index, count)

pages.purpose: Service chooser, device hubs, stream start/stop, quick people graphics
Logo on/off, catalog refresh, bimah and booth audio
Graphics that can come up in any service
Index of every carried device page
Carried camera, AV and audio pages

columns.order: Each service page is one stretch of a service; its graphics columns read left to right in liturgical order.

fixed.keys: switcher: Center cam 1, Left cam 2, Right cam 3, Merge (service pages)
output recovery: Animate out, Clear now, Logo (and Be Right Back in r3)
navigation: Prev, Home, Next, Bimah Mute

growth.rule: One ordered key per panel, down the column; a set that fills its column continues at the top of the next column (L'cha Dodi on Fri 2: c3 -> c4 -> c5).

labels.rule: The label names the piece and carries the panel number: "<piece> i/n", or the verse number with its incipit ("2 Likrat").

colours.meaning: Colour shows a key's role, never the piece: every panel of a set (and an alternate that belongs to a set) is teal.

keyTypes: Graphics: one-step Toggle cue keys in c1-c5 of service pages, with Requested and Rendered lights; on Friday pages some carry the two-step camera gesture.
Switcher: camera merge keys with vMix tally in c0, Merge in c0 r3.
Recovery in c6, navigation and Bimah Mute in c7, on every service page.
Device keys (stream, audio, Reaper, VLC) on Home, Output & Audio, Cameras and the carried pages.
